answer: Latency triangulation: each epoch the beacon picks 5 verifier nodes on different continents to ping every earning key with a signed nonce. The round-trip times form a fingerprint, and keys whose fingerprints match within 3 ms on 15 of 20 epochs are one grove: they split a single reward. A host can pad delay but never remove it, since light crossing an ocean costs ~60 ms, and padded sets fail the triangle check. So 100 fakes need 100 hosts in truly separate cities (~$5/month each, $500 total), and timber-thin VPN tricks only add lag.
